risk_flags.description: The contract promises to update only one pinned assertion, but the project rules say rate changes may require multiple pinned expectations to move together. I would require the agent to commit to updating every affected pinned expectation, not just this named test.
The contract omits the required callout that changing a fixed rate affects historical totals. This matters because the requirements explicitly say that impact must be surfaced when the rate changes.
risk_flags.span: the change should be called out because it alters every historical total that used that currency

verdict.primary_risk: The main risk is that the promise is too narrow: it updates one assertion but does not commit to all affected pinned expectations or the required historical-total impact callout.
